authority: Ministry of Finance / Government of India
compounding_frequency: Annually (calculated monthly on min balance between 5th and end of month)
tax_status: EEE (Exempt-Exempt-Exempt: Deposit, Interest, and Maturity Proceeds are 100% tax-free)
loan_facility: Available from 3rd financial year up to 25% of balance at end of 2nd preceding year
premature_closure_rules: Permitted after 5 full financial years for life-threatening illness or higher education, with 1% interest deduction
